description: Asks Ask Momentic a question and returns its answer, written by AI from momenticmarketing.com pages, with the Momentic pages it is based on as sources. Use it for questions about Momentic (services, Atlas, the team, case studies, pricing) and about SEO and AI search topics Momentic publishes research on, such as AI chatbot market share, AI Overviews, llms.txt, AI crawlers or query fan out. A question someone asked before returns at once; a new one takes about 30 seconds. If the result says the answer is still being written, call the tool again with the same question after about 30 seconds.

question.description: The question, in plain words (2 to 200 characters).

name: ask_momentic
